killedBy: the legal block renderer puts document text in as text, so a document cannot inject markup
why: Turns the one promise legal.ts's header makes into its opposite: every heading, paragraph, note, list item and table cell in five legal documents would be parsed as HTML. Today no committed document contains markup -- the generator's `assertSupported` rejects inline HTML and `inlineText` flattens the rest -- so EVERY assertion driven from `LEGAL_DOCUMENTS` passes on this mutation, byte for byte, and the pane looks identical. The case that kills it uses a hostile fixture (``) precisely because the shipped data cannot expose the difference, and it checks the child count as well as the text, since `innerHTML` of a string with no valid tags still round-trips through `textContent`.
